name: message
description: A chat message component that displays messages from users, assistants, or system prompts with optional avatars
designIntent: The Message component renders individual chat messages with proper styling based on the message role (user, assistant, system, tool). It handles avatar display, timestamps, and different visual treatments to distinguish between message types in a conversation interface.

props.name: message
props.description: The message object containing role, content, and optional metadata

props.name: showAvatar
props.description: Whether to show the avatar for the message

props.name: avatarFallback
props.description: Fallback text to show when avatar image is not available

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the message container

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Custom renderer (e.g. markdown); replaces default plain-text rendering.

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: Shows a typing cursor and sets aria-busy while the response is still generating.

props.name: userLabel
props.description: Display name for user messages; enables localization.

props.name: assistantLabel
props.description: Display name for assistant messages; enables localization.

examples.title: User message
examples.code: <Message message={{ id: '1', role: 'user', content: 'Hello, how are you?' }} />
examples.description: Message from the user with default avatar

examples.title: Assistant message
examples.code: <Message message={{ id: '2', role: 'assistant', content: 'I\'m doing well, thank you!' }} />

examples.title: With custom avatar
examples.code:
<Message 
  message={{ id: '4', role: 'assistant', content: 'Hello' }}
  avatarSrc="/ai-avatar.png"
  avatarFallback="AI"
/>
examples.description: Message with custom avatar image and fallback

examples.title: Without avatar
examples.code:
<Message 
  message={{ id: '5', role: 'user', content: 'Quick message' }}
  showAvatar={false}
/>
examples.description: Message with avatar hidden for more compact display

antiPatterns.title: Don't use for complex content
antiPatterns.explanation: Message content should be plain text. For complex UI, use additional components.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hardcode message data
antiPatterns.explanation: Messages should come from a conversation state, not be hardcoded

accessibility.implementation: Message role and content are announced. Avatar has proper alt text from fallback or role
accessibility.userRequirements: Ensure avatarFallback is meaningful when avatarSrc is used

accessibility.implementation: User and assistant messages have distinct background colors with proper contrast
accessibility.userRequirements: Test color contrast in both light and dark modes

accessibility.implementation: Message is rendered as a div with proper ARIA attributes for role identification
accessibility.userRequirements: Consider adding aria-live regions for streaming messages

guidelines: Content should be plain text, not HTML
Support markdown formatting if needed (apply at wrapper level)
Use proper punctuation and grammar for assistant messages
For user messages, preserve user's original formatting
goodExamples: I can help you with that task.
Let me explain step by step.

guidelines: Ensure high contrast with avatar background

compositionRules.relationship: Messages are typically rendered within a Conversation component that manages the message list
New messages from PromptInput should be added to the message list and rendered as Message components
